Only pay for what you need

  • Pay for channels, not seats

    Most clients have a handful of channels. You only pay for those channels, and everyone on your team can log in freely.

  • The more you manage, the less you pay

Add your whole team for free

  • Everyone gets their own login

    Unlimited team members on the Team plan means no shared passwords and no user caps to work around.

  • Add freelancers and contractors freely

    Bring people on for a project, remove them when it wraps, at no extra cost.

  • Run your whole portfolio from one account

    One place for every client, every channel.

  • Keep access clean and accountable

    Individual logins make audits and compliance straightforward.

Reports worth handing over

  • The report is the deliverable

    Hand clients a clean PDF every month instead of rebuilding a deck from scratch.

  • Show the value of every channel

    Cross-channel analytics in one view, so clients can see how their content is performing.

  • Report on any timeframe

    Pull performance for any date range, from a monthly retainer to a one-off campaign.

  • Tell the story behind the numbers

    Layer your analysis onto the numbers so clients get insights, not just charts.

Client access, your way

  • Keep clients in the loop, not in the way

    Route content for sign-off before it goes live, and give clients a clear view of what's queued.

  • Set the level of oversight each client needs

    Tight approvals for some, trusted auto-publish for others.

  • Control who sees what

    Permissions keep each client's work separate.

  • Onboard a client in minutes

    Add their channels, set their access, and you're live.

FAQs

Can I manage multiple clients in Buffer?

Yes. You can keep client work organized so scheduling, approvals, and reporting are easier to run across multiple accounts without losing track.

How does per-channel pricing work as my agency grows?

Buffer uses volume discounts for channels. That means your price per channel gets lower once you manage more channels, so adding more social profiles scales more affordably.

In practice, channels 1–10 are priced at the standard rate, and any channels above 10 cost less per channel. Your total may increase as you add channels, but your average cost per channel goes down as you grow.

How do permission levels work?

Buffer's permissions levels let you choose who can post to each of your channels. You can assign different access levels, from full posting access to approval-only roles. This keeps your content secure while giving your team the flexibility they need. Learn more about team member permission levels.

How does the approval workflow work?

Team members can draft posts and submit them for approval. Admins or managers can review, edit, and approve before they're scheduled to go live. Learn more about managing and approving drafts.

Can I create and export custom reports with Buffer?

Yes, you can create and export beautiful, on-brand custom reports. You can add all types of metrics, tables, and charts from your dashboard to your reports and download them as PDFs or images. The ability to create custom reports is available on all paid plans.

What is the Buffer Agency Partner Program?

The Buffer Agency Partner Program is for agencies and freelancers who manage clients on Buffer. Partners get early access to new features, a private community of fellow agencies, priority support, and earn 25% recurring commission on new clients they bring to Buffer through their referral link.
